feed.title: IndaVillas blog
feed.subtitle: Market data on 5+ bedroom villas in Bali, and practical notes on listings, photography, pricing, reviews and guest communication.

entry.title: 5 questions to ask a Bali villa management company before you sign
entry.summary: Who reviews my prices? What is in the monthly report? Who answers guests at 2am? What does it cost in total? What if I leave? What a good answer sounds like.

entry.title: Building a villa in Bali? Four decisions to make before your first listing
entry.summary: Most launch problems start months earlier. Decide who the villa is for, what similar villas really earn, who runs the house and what the first guests will see.

entry.title: A guest messages at 2am: what should happen next
entry.summary: The air conditioning stops, or the taxi cannot find the gate. A simple night plan for villa owners: who answers, how to sort the problem, and when to wake the team.

entry.title: Do higher Airbnb ratings mean more revenue? What 1,439 Bali villas show
entry.summary: Bali villas rated 4.85 or higher earned a median of $65,900 a year. Villas under 4.5 earned $30,500. Where the gap opens, and what an owner controls.

entry.title: Where 5 star villa reviews come from: scent, light, comfort, clarity
entry.summary: Five star reviews rarely come from the pool. They come from how a room smells, whether the lamp works, how the bed feels and how clear the arrival message is.

entry.title: The last ten minutes before a guest arrives: a villa checklist
entry.summary: Guests never mention the crease you fixed. They mention the one you missed. A written ten minute checklist for your villa team, from the gate to the bedroom.

entry.title: What a 5+ bedroom villa in Bali earns: occupancy, nightly rate and revenue
entry.summary: The median Bali villa with 5+ bedrooms was 44% occupied and earned $46,000 in the year to October 2026. The top quarter earned $101,700. Data by size and area.

entry.title: Villa revenue management vs full management: who does what
entry.summary: Full villa management runs the house for a share of every booking. Revenue management keeps your team and works on rate, listing and reach for a flat fee.

entry.title: Your first Airbnb photo has one job: earn the click
entry.summary: Your Airbnb cover photo decides whether a guest opens your villa or scrolls past. How to choose it, test it at thumbnail size and plan the shoot around it.
